value.name: Systematic Transfer Option (STO)
value.mechanics: annual or single premium goes to the Liquid Fund, then 1/12, 1/11 ... of the units move each month to one of four equity funds

value.name: Return Protector Option (RPO)
value.mechanics: premium goes to one of four equity funds and gains of 5% to 15% (chosen) move to the Debt Fund

value.name: Auto Funds Rebalancing (AFR)
value.mechanics: rebalanced to the chosen proportions every 3 months

value.name: Safety Switch Option (SSO)
value.mechanics: units move to the Liquid Fund over the last 4 policy years: 30%, 60%, 90% then 100% in the Liquid Fund

value.name: Loss Protector Strategy (LPS)
value.mechanics: premium goes to one equity fund and units move to the Debt Fund when the loss reaches 10% to 30% (chosen)
